name: Dr Jake L. Greenfield
bio: Jake grew up in Bristol (UK) and completed his MSci in Chemistry at Imperial College London. He earned his PhD at the University of Cambridge under the supervision of Prof. Jonathan Nitschke, where he worked on the self-assembly of helical metallopolymers. Jake then joined Prof. Matthew Fuchter’s group at Imperial College London as a postdoctoral researcher, working on molecular photoswitches. In 2022, he moved to Würzburg, Germany as a Humboldt Fellow with Prof. Frank Würthner. From 2023 to 2025, he led the Greenfield Group in Würzburg as a Liebig Fellow and was appointed an Emil-Fischer Fellow in 2024. In October 2025, he joined the University of St Andrews as a Lecturer in Organic Chemistry. His group studies photoswitchable imines and light-driven out-of-equilibrium chemistry. Beyond the science, Jake is passionate about mentoring researchers, collaborative teamwork, and enjoys drinking too much coffee...
